name: Dashboards
description: Configurable dashboards of widgets (default: Activities Dashboard, tab 353503).
howItWorks: Landing opens the Activities Dashboard; Export and Edit buttons were disabled on landing. Widgets summarise CRM data across modules.

name: Contacts
description: Leads/contacts the team sells to. Table with saved views (All contacts, 14 more views).
howItWorks: Table listing (default view id 402015942732, sorted by lead score) with name, account, job title, email, mobile, status, tags, sales owner. Toolbar: Customize table, Import contacts, Add contact, Table/other view toggle, Bulk actions, Filter by. Detail page at /contacts/<id>. Contact status uses lifecycle stages. 2 contacts exist (AgentTest Lead ...).
mutationNotes: Existing data are AgentTest records created by earlier runs; do not delete anything not created this run.

name: Accounts
description: Companies associated with contacts and deals.
howItWorks: Table listing with views, filter, bulk actions, Add account; detail page per account. Contacts and deals link to accounts.

name: Deals
description: Sales opportunities in pipelines; Pipeline (kanban) view by default plus table view.
howItWorks: Default view is a pipeline board with stage columns showing weighted value; 17 deals visible in All deals. Add deal, filter, view toggle (Pipeline/Table), bulk actions. Deals reference contacts and accounts and a pipeline/stage.

name: Conversations (Email inbox)
description: Email inbox: Team Inbox, Inbox, Sent, Scheduled, Drafts, Trash, Email Templates.
howItWorks: Landing prompts 'Connect your Inbox to Freshsales' and a choice of email provider; no mailbox connected in this tenant, so mail lists are empty. Awaiting-response is the default route.
mutationNotes: Connecting a mailbox needs third-party OAuth; not attempted.

name: Analytics (Reports)
description: Reports library with Curated reports and New Report.
howItWorks: Landing lists curated reports; New Report and Help Center buttons. Reports cover contacts, deals, activities.

name: Products and Quotes (CPQ)
description: Product catalog (Products list) and quote documents (Add Quote) with CPQ settings and document templates.
howItWorks: Products list at /products (view id 402015942778). Quotes are created via quick-create 'Add Quote'; settings under Admin Settings > Account Settings > CPQ Settings and Document Templates (Quotes). No Products/Quotes link in the main left nav; reached via URL or the + menu.

name: Sales Sequences
description: Automated multi-step outreach sequences for contacts.
howItWorks: Landing redirects to /sales-sequences/filters; creation wizard at /sales-sequences/contact/new (linked from setup guide and + menu).

name: Sales Activities (tasks, meetings, calls)
navPath: Quick-create (+) > Add task / Add meeting / Add call log / Send SMS
Admin Settings > Deals & Pipelines > Sales Activities
description: Tasks, meetings, call logs and SMS recorded against records; activity types configured in settings.
howItWorks: No standalone tasks page (/crm/sales/tasks returns Page Not Found). Activities are created from the + menu or from record detail pages; activity types are configured at settings/sales-activity-type; the Activities Dashboard summarises them.

name: Admin: Fields, Custom Modules and Lifecycle
description: Customise contact/account fields, custom modules, lifecycle stages, scoring and lead-capture.
howItWorks: Group lists: Website Embed Code (marketer app), Contacts (/settings/contacts/forms), Accounts (/settings/sales_accounts/forms), Custom Modules (/settings/module-customization), Contact Lifecycle Stages, Contact Scoring (predictive_scoring, Freddy), Web Forms, CRM Code Library, LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms. Account Settings group adds Tags, Currency.

name: Admin: Deals, Pipelines and Forecasting
description: Deal fields, pipelines/stages, sales activity types, quotas and forecasting.
howItWorks: Group lists Deals (/settings/deals/forms), Sales Activities, Pipelines (/settings/deal_pipeline), Quotas and Forecasting (/settings/sales-forecast; direct navigation errored/was blocked, possibly plan-gated, unverified).

name: Admin: Users, Roles, Territories
description: Users, roles, territories, auto-assignment rules, conversation groups.
howItWorks: Links: Auto-assignment Rules, Users, Roles (/settings/roles), Territories, Conversation Groups (messaging app).
mutationNotes: Inviting users emails real addresses; avoid in full-run unless approved.

name: Admin: Data Import and Migration
description: Imports for contacts, accounts, deals, custom modules, products, users; migrations from Salesforce, Insightly, Zoho, Pipedrive, SalesforceIQ, HubSpot; Import History.
howItWorks: Tile page; each tile starts an import wizard (file upload). Import History at /import-history.
mutationNotes: Imports create many records; only with a purpose-built file in full-run.

name: Admin: Email and Channels
description: Email templates, create-contacts-from-email, team inbox, email domains and (messaging app) chat/WhatsApp/SMS/etc channels.
howItWorks: Sales app pages: settings/email/incoming, settings/email/team-inbox, settings/email/templates. Many channel and conversation settings live under /crm/messaging/settings/* (same origin, separate sub-app) -- web chat, WhatsApp, SMS, Facebook, Instagram, LINE, Apple Messages, SLA, canned responses, CSAT, labels, skills, etc. Marketing Email Configuration and Email Domains live under /crm/marketer.

name: Admin: Apps and Integrations
description: Marketplace apps, tasks-and-tickets, conversation integrations/webhooks/mobile app.
howItWorks: Marketplace Apps list at third-party-applications/view/all; conversation integrations and webhooks under /crm/messaging/settings.

name: Admin: Account and CRM Settings
description: Global CRM settings, Audit Log, Announcements, Currency, Tags, Battlecards, CPQ settings, Plans & Billing, Freddy AI, agent status, business hours.
howItWorks: Links: CRM Settings, Account Settings, Audit Log (/settings/audit-logs), Announcements, Currency, Tags, Battlecards (/settings/cms/solutions), CPQ Settings, Plans & Billing (/subscriptions, trial ends in 8 days).
mutationNotes: Plans and Billing must not be changed.

name: Freshworks Admin Center
navPath: Freshworks Switcher > Admin Center (or root URL /)
description: Organization-level console: users, subscriptions, security, organization, audit logs.
howItWorks: Root URL shows profile (Org Admin), org URL, My Accounts (Freshworks CRM tile to /crm/sales), explore other products, and Move Account form. Nav: Users (/users-groups/users), My Subscriptions, Security (/security/agents), Organization, Audit Logs.
mutationNotes: Move Account and organization edits are out of scope.

name: Lists (Marketing Lists)
description: Contact groupings for campaigns (per API docs).
howItWorks: Direct navigation to /crm/sales/lists returned 403 'You are not authorised to perform this operation'.
unreachableReason: 403 Access Denied at /crm/sales/lists; not in nav

name: Workflows
howItWorks: /crm/sales/workflows and /settings/workflows return Page Not Found; no Workflows entry in Admin Settings for this trial plan/role.
unreachableReason: Page Not Found; no nav entry in this tenant (likely plan-gated)
